name: usage-card-previews
goal: Catalog and relationship items share clickable consumer footers and revision-bound screenshot previews

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: PR16 reused the catalog renderer but page cards kept the minimal branch and component usages remained flattened names, omitting the requested linked footer.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: entity-relations and responsive usage tests asserted component classes and names, not consumer footers. Extend the existing card, usage and helper-hover matrices at tip and historical commits.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed red 201046d7: the unchanged responsive matrix fails on missing relationship usage groups and absent helper screenshot previews. Before screenshots inspected.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use one generated consumer footer and preview link in every catalog card and table; retain full revision-scoped consumer entities. Extend the existing interaction matrix and shared-component review gate.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Shared generated footer and preview link now serve page/component/helper cards and table cells. Revision-scoped entities and common navigation are retained. Existing six responsive cases and 40 unit tests pass unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
